# New Politics

> An independent socialist journal and forum for leftist political analysis, commentary, and debate on imperialism, labor, and global justice.

New Politics publishes in-depth articles, book reviews, and editorial commentary on contemporary political issues from a socialist perspective. The journal features contributions from prominent left-wing intellectuals and maintains archives spanning decades of socialist thought and activism.

## Key Topics

- socialist politics
- left politics
- anti-imperialism
- political analysis
- international socialism
- Trump administration
- Iran conflict
- editorial policy
- book reviews
- labor movements
- US foreign policy
- Venezuela
- China
- Ukraine
- fundraising

## Core Information

- [home - New Politics](https://newpol.org): Homepage featuring socialist political analysis and commentary by Kevin B. Anderson
- [About New Politics - New Politics](https://newpol.org/about): About page describing New Politics as independent socialist journal and forum
- [Why We Publish - New Politics](https://newpol.org/about/why-we-publish): Mission statement explaining New Politics' socialist editorial policy and vision
- [What They Say - New Politics](https://newpol.org/about/what-they-say): Testimonials from Noam Chomsky, Cornel West, and other left-wing intellectuals

## Articles & Analysis

- [Issues Archive - New Politics](http://newpol.org/issues): Archive of back issues covering labor, climate, reproductive rights, and socialism
- [Online Features - New Politics](https://newpol.org/online-features): Online articles on anti-war activism, Iran conflict, labor history, and geopolitics
- [From The Editors - New Politics](https://newpol.org/issue_post/from-the-editors-14): Editorial commentary on Trump, Venezuela, Gaza, Ukraine, and US foreign policy
- [Trump and Netanyahu's Lurch into Iran: Imperial Hubris in the Wake of a People's Uprising - New Politics](https://newpol.org/trump-and-netanyahus-lurch-into-iran-imperial-hubris-in-the-wake-of-a-peoples-uprising): Analysis by Kevin B. Anderson on US-Israel Iran policy and imperialism
- [New Politics Vol. XX No. 4, Whole Number 80 - New Politics](https://newpol.org/issues/new-politics-vol-xx-no-4-whole-number-80): Journal issue featuring political analysis on Trump, Venezuela, and justice topics

## Book Reviews

- [Realism in Revolt - New Politics](https://newpol.org/review/realism-in-revolt): Book review of anarchist political philosophy by Daphne Lawless and William Gillis
- [Comparing China, Cuba, and Vietnam - New Politics](https://newpol.org/review/comparing-china-cuba-and-vietnam): Book review comparing socialism in China, Cuba, and Vietnam by Samuel Farber
